name: Orion Torrent Client
tagline: Modern, feature-rich BitTorrent client and streaming platform for Linux
blurb: Orion is a modern, powerful, and lightweight BitTorrent client with an elegant user interface and advanced streaming capabilities for Linux Desktop.
description:
Orion is a modern, powerful, and lightweight BitTorrent client with an elegant user interface and advanced streaming capabilities for Linux Desktop. Built with Qt6 and optimized for performance, it brings a seamless experience to torrenting and media playback.

Key Features:

• Complete magnet link, torrent file, and torrent hash support

• Bookmark management feature. Allows bookmarking your favourite torrents for quick access.

• Integrated streaming player for video, audio, and images directly from torrents

• Ultra-optimized downloading engine for smooth, lag-free streaming

• Flexible speed throttling to control download and upload bandwidth per task

• Built-in media player superior playback quality

• Concurrent multi-torrent downloading with independent port allocation

• Enhanced security with app lock and passcode protection

• Advanced torrent search with age-restricted content filtering

• Persistent cache system for faster torrent reloading

• Share torrents and downloaded content directly with peers

• Comprehensive torrent information display and detailed task management

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
